page_intro: There are different ways to obtain your first bitcoins. The most common way to start are the exchanges — they behave like a bank: create an account, fill in your personal information (KYC, Know Your Customer) and start operating. Always check reputation and fees. But remember: not your keys, not your coins. After some months, move your bitcoin to your own wallet.
exchange_kraken_body: Easy to set up and robust reputation after years of operating. Solid option with web and app. Fees are mid-range. The first step.
exchange_mexc_body: If you want a low-fee option (with some complexity), MEXC positions itself as a solid exchange — aggressive on fees and with a huge range of possibilities, though they can feel overwhelming if you only want to buy Bitcoin.
exchange_hodlhodl_subtitle: Without traces for those who value privacy
exchange_hodlhodl_body: Contact other people directly and make the deal without exposing your identity. Don't reuse addresses. Everyone here values their privacy. One of the most trusted P2P platforms.
custody_intro: One of the biggest mantras of the Bitcoin community is to store your own bitcoin outside exchanges. Leaving your bitcoin on the exchange makes no sense — you're trusting an intermediary. For small amounts it's fine to start, but once you start stacking sats, consider self-custody. Write your seed phrase on paper, offline, make a couple of copies, and store them somewhere safe. If you lose those 12/24 words, you lose everything. You are your own bank.
wallet_trezor_body: Open source, affordable, robust. You don't need more. The first step.
wallet_ellipal_body: The most secure combination: no USB, no connectivity, no NFC — just scanning QR codes from your phone. So secure you'll occasionally forget how to use it. Advanced.
wallet_tangem_body: Your ring becomes your wallet using NFC paired with your phone. Never lose it, move millions with your finger.
wallet_bluewallet_body: Free hot wallet for your phone. Like a coin wallet in your pocket — convenient, but remember it can be hacked.
wallet_satoshi_body: Mobile Lightning wallet for bitcoin. Simple to use. Custodial — you trust them. Convenient for quick payments but not for storing large amounts.
